article_framing_rejections.headline: U.S. Marshals arrest biological father in Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death

lead_independence.headline: U.S. Marshals arrest biological father in Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death
lead_independence.lead: U.S. Marshals Service arrested Jason Gunter, 45, Tuesday at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia, on a warrant obtained by St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office detectives investigating the death of his 3-month-old son. Gunter is charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County. He is the fourth person arrested in connection with the infant's death. The child's mother, 27-year-old Nicole Maxwell, the child's grandfather Robert Maxwell, and Robert Maxwell's girlfriend, 38-year-old Vikki Koon, were previously charged with aggravated manslaughter of a child and aggravated child abuse and are each held on $1.5 million bond.

article_framing_rejections.headline: St. Lucie County detectives serve warrant at Fort Pierce home in Southern Truss fraud investigation

lead_independence.headline: St. Lucie County detectives serve warrant at Fort Pierce home in Southern Truss fraud investigation
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office confirmed to CBS12 News that deputies served a search warrant Tuesday as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Westlake population nears 5,500 homes with Walmart superstore and Lowe's coming to Town Center West

lead_independence.headline: Westlake population nears 5,500 homes with Walmart superstore and Lowe's coming to Town Center West
lead_independence.lead: The city of Westlake has grown rapidly since its founding in 2016, with the population reaching about 3,880 homes and another 1,600 homes approved but not yet built, Mayor J.P. O'Connor said. Walmart purchased a 24-acre site in Town Center West near Seminole Pratt Whitney Road and 60th Street North where the company will build a 188,779-square-foot superstore featuring a full grocery store, pharmacy, garden center, automotive center, vision center, convenience store and gas station. The store will sit next to a Lowe's Home Improvement store, which will also serve as a regional headquarters.
